evidence: Initializes the caller output to zero, reads the current and configured values through the global context pointer, checks context status selectors 0 and 0x13, and when those states pass calls the record predicate helper and writes its boolean result to the output pointer. The exact meaning of the compared values is unresolved; name describes the observable output and gating. decompiled/main/main_0124.c:6019-6046.

Both control paths store byte value 1 through the pointer loaded from global address 0x7002280000+0x518. The true path first checks context status selector 0x18; the other path calls a helper with the input bit. Each path then calls follow-up helpers, including a tailcall in one branch. decompiled/main/main_0049.c:36268-36302; indexed callers at decompiled/main/main_0049.c:34989-34993.

Initializes the output to zero, follows a global lookup and context selector checks, then passes a stack output pointer to an unnamed helper before conditionally writing the helper-produced value. The helper and resulting value domain are not established. decompiled/main/main_0124.c:51243-51271.

Selects one of two record bases from the input selector, reads the record fields at +0x584 and +0x588, computes a table entry from the selected base and value, prepares update arguments, and musttail forwards to update_generated_attribute_rating_curve. Caller loads the record context and invokes this routine as part of the update path. decompiled/main/main_0016.c:54441-54471; caller decompiled/main/main_0024.c:6401-6406.

Initializes the output to zero, queries a helper for an object pointer, reads a signed 16-bit value at object offset 0x1a, and conditionally stores it based on the value and context status selector 0x13. The object role and field meaning remain unsupported. decompiled/main/main_0124.c:49953-49980.
